title: Preparation of Aqueous Extracts of Plants
author: Cecilia Mónica Rodríguez García
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.szwef7e

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Leaves
steps.instruction: Collect fresh leaves from the field and prepare them for drying.

substeps.instruction: Wash leaves with tap water in the lab
Remove excess water using a kitchen centrifuge

steps.title: Dry the Leaves
steps.instruction: Dry the prepared leaves and store them.

substeps.instruction: Place in a stove at 50 °C for 2-3 days
Store in plastic bags until use

steps.title: Blend Dry Leaves
steps.instruction: Blend the dry leaves in a laboratory blender at maximum speed for 00:01:30, stirring with a spatula every 30 seconds.

steps.title: Mix with Distilled Water
steps.instruction: Add sterile distilled water to the blended leaves and mix for 00:01:30.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pour the mixture into 50 mL falcon tubes and centrifuge for 00:30:00 at 3220 g.

steps.title: Aliquot and Second Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant and distribute it into 2 mL eppendorf tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pour 1800 μL of supernatant into each 2 mL eppendorf tube
Centrifuge the tubes for 00:30:00 at 20817 g at room temperature

steps.title: Collect and Filter Extract
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant from all tubes into a container and perform sequential filtration.

substeps.instruction: Filter the aqueous extract using a 0.65 μm membrane in a Swinnex filter
Filter the resulting liquid again using a 0.45 μm membrane in a Swinnex filter

steps.title: Sterilize and Store Extract
steps.instruction: Sterilize the extract and store it under controlled conditions.

substeps.instruction: In a laminar flow hood, sterilize the extract by filtration using a 0.22 μm membrane in a Swinnex filter
Store the sterile aqueous extract in a 50 mL falcon tube in the dark at 4 °C until use
